companies.name: CharacterQuilt
companies.originalOneLiner: Computer use agents to deploy enterprise marketing campaigns
companies.originalDescription: CharacterQuilt builds computer use agents to deploy enterprise marketing campaigns. Marketers today don’t actually do much marketing at all. Today, over 80% of time spent on launching a marketing campaign is actually ops work: tweaking automation flows in Pardot, configuring audiences in LinkedIn, or wiring HTML emails in Marketo. What’s crazy about enterprise marketing is companies pay agencies millions of dollars just to deploy campaigns in their systems — and they still have to wait weeks for each one. CharacterQuilt is AI infrastructure for marketing teams: a brain that learns your brand, and agents that operate your existing tools. Marketing campaigns that used to take 3 agencies, 10 tools, and 6 weeks are now being built, designed, and deployed from CQ in an hour. Customers submit a brief like they would send to a human teammate or marketing agency, and they get back fully designed and deployed campaigns. Teams like 1upHealth, ABC Fitness, and Emplifi use us to: 1-) Build segments/audiences faster 2-) Create on-brand creative (AI is terrible at staying on-brand) 3-) Deploy campaigns automatically into HubSpot, WordPress, LinkedIn etc. We replicate your brand guidelines, deeply understand past campaigns, and work inside your systems. If you run demand gen or lifecycle at a B2B/B2C company and want to ship campaigns faster, send us a brief and we’ll build it in 15 minutes.
companies.story: 这家公司做的是企业营销自动化基础设施。想象你是一家大公司的营销负责人，每次上线一个营销活动，都要在好几个企业软件之间来回切换，调整自动化流程、配置受众、修改邮件模板，这些琐碎操作占掉你八成的时间，还要等外包公司好几周。CharacterQuilt 的人工智能智能体能学习你的品牌，直接操作你现有的工具，把以前要三个代理、十种工具、六周才能完成的营销活动，缩短到一个小时。你只需要像给同事发消息一样提交一份简报，它就能帮你设计并部署好整个活动。这家公司来自 YC 春季 2026 批次，目前团队四人，正在招人。

companies.name: Minicor
companies.originalOneLiner: Scalable windows desktop automations
companies.originalDescription: Minicor connects AI startups to legacy desktop apps that have no API. Reliably, quickly and at scale. Describe a workflow and get an API endpoint. Each call triggers a self-healing desktop automation on a Windows VM. On-prem, cloud, or Citrix. Build through your coding agent via our MCP. Complete with the observability tools to manage your customer relationship: full video replay of every automation, granular logging, and slack enabled alerts.
companies.story: 这家公司解决的是没有接口的旧桌面软件的自动化问题。假如你是一家公司的技术负责人，想把人工智能接入公司用了多年的老系统，但这些系统没有接口，数据拿不出来，流程也改不了。Minicor 能把你的工作流程描述变成一个接口端点，每次调用都会在 Windows 虚拟机上触发一次自动修复的桌面自动化操作，支持本地、云端或 Citrix 环境。它还提供完整的视频回放和日志，让你能清楚看到每次操作过程。这家公司来自 YC 春季 2026 批次，团队七人，正在招聘。

companies.name: Runtime
companies.originalOneLiner: Build and run internal agents, without managing the infrastructure
companies.originalDescription: Runtime (runtm.com) gives engineering teams control and visibility to enable anyone in their org to use coding agents securely. Eng leaders rolling out coding agents have no way to see what's happening, set boundaries, or safely let non-engineers use them. We provide sandboxed environments, session-level observability, and configurable guardrails so anyone on your team can ship with coding agents without breaking prod. We're live with fast-growing YC scaleups empowering their Engineers, PMs, designers, marketers, and ops to contribute to their codebase or build prod-grade zero-to-one apps.
companies.story: 这家公司做的是让整个组织都能安全使用编程智能体的基础设施。想象你是一位工程负责人，团队里每个人都在用编程智能体写代码，但你完全看不到他们在干什么，也没法设置权限，更不敢让非工程师碰代码库。Runtime 提供沙盒环境、会话级监控和可配置的护栏，让工程师、产品经理、设计师、市场人员都能安全地用智能体贡献代码，或者从零搭建生产级应用。这家公司来自 YC 春季 2026 批次，团队三人，正在招聘，并且已经有一些快速成长的 YC 公司客户。

companies.name: Allowance
companies.originalOneLiner: The spend control layer for AI agents
companies.originalDescription: Allowance lets AI agents make purchases on a user’s behalf without ever exposing your real card number. Users approve purchases directly from their iPhone with customizable controls like spending limits, merchant restrictions, and expiration windows. Once approved, Allowance generates scoped, one-time payment credentials designed specifically for that transaction. This enables AI agents to safely complete tasks like shopping, ordering food, booking reservations, or purchasing tickets while keeping humans in control of every payment.
companies.story: 这家公司做的是人工智能智能体的支付控制层。想象你是一个忙碌的上班族，想让智能体帮你订餐、购物或买票，但又不敢把真实银行卡号交给它。Allowance 让你在 iPhone 上直接审批每一笔支付，还能设置消费限额、商户限制和有效期。一旦你批准，它会生成一张只用于该次交易的临时支付凭据，这样智能体就能安全地替你完成各种购买，而你始终掌握支付控制权。这家公司来自 YC 春季 2026 批次，目前只有一人，但产品已经很有想法。

companies.name: Huscarl
companies.originalOneLiner: AI-native actuary enabling self-insurance for corporations
companies.originalDescription: Huscarl is building an autonomous AI actuary to enable self-insurance for corporations. Large companies use insurance subsidiaries ("captives") to self-insure their risks. Some of these captives are larger than regional insurers. We provide them the actuarial and modeling layer to operate and grow. We're building a future where self-insurance is the default, and commercial insurance the exception. This is the best way to solve the inefficiencies of the $1T corporate insurance market.
companies.story: 这家公司做的是企业自保的保险精算软件。想象你是一家大型企业的风险管理负责人，公司通过自保子公司来承保自身风险，但精算建模非常复杂，需要专业团队和昂贵软件。Huscarl 提供一个人工智能精算师，帮助这些自保公司完成精算和建模工作，让他们能更高效地运营和扩展。这家公司来自 YC 春季 2026 批次，团队两人，正在招聘，目标是改变万亿美元规模的企业保险市场。

companies.name: Shiraz AI
companies.originalOneLiner: Robots that learn on the job
companies.originalDescription: We deploy robots that learn new tasks from a single human demonstration in the factory. We're starting in contract manufacturing, where lines change every week and both traditional automation and today's VLAs fall over. Our founding team has 20+ years of experience in robotics. Navid was part of the core team that productized Spot at Boston Dynamics and led manipulation projects there. Before that, he was at Rethink Robotics. Mojtaba led whole-body control and manipulation efforts at Amazon Robotics and was a Research Assistant Professor at Northwestern University.
companies.story: 这家公司做的是能在工厂里现场学习的机器人。想象你是一家合同制造厂的车间主管，生产线每周都要换，传统自动化设备根本跟不上，而现有人工智能机器人也经常出错。Shiraz AI 的机器人只需要一次人工演示就能学会新任务，特别适合产线频繁切换的场景。创始团队有二十多年机器人经验，核心成员来自波士顿动力和亚马逊机器人。这家公司来自 YC 夏季 2026 批次，团队两人，虽然还在早期，但技术方向很值得关注。

companies.name: Rovi Health
companies.originalOneLiner: AI healthcare concierge for employees
companies.originalDescription: We deliver high-quality, cost-effective healthcare to employees through text. Employers cut 10–20% of healthcare spend. Employees get concierge care that improves outcomes. Our AI agents analyze clinical data to identify care needs. We treat common conditions through our integrated virtual clinic. For more complex care, our agents find the best in-network providers using millions of price and quality data points, and handle end-to-end appointment booking.
companies.story: 这家公司做的是员工医疗保健的人工智能管家。想象你是一家公司的人力资源负责人，员工看病流程繁琐，公司医疗支出年年上涨。Rovi Health 通过短信为员工提供医疗管家服务，人工智能智能体分析临床数据，识别护理需求，处理常见病，并为复杂病症找到性价比最高的网络内医生，全程帮忙预约。雇主可以削减百分之十到二十的医疗支出，员工也能获得更好的护理。这家公司来自 YC 秋季 2025 批次，团队三人，正在招聘。

companies.name: Infera
companies.originalOneLiner: Control lab instruments with natural language.
companies.originalDescription: Describe an experiment in plain English, and Infera turns it into a validated, instrument-ready run across the equipment your lab already uses. Infera handles the protocol logic, vendor-specific scripts, data, inventory, and institutional knowledge in one system. An AI-native compiler for the lab: one system from intent to execution.
companies.story: 这家公司做的是实验室仪器的自然语言控制。想象你是一位生物技术研究员，每天要花大量时间写实验方案、转换仪器脚本、处理数据。Infera 让你直接用英语描述实验，它就能生成经过验证的、仪器可执行的完整流程，处理协议逻辑、厂商脚本、数据、库存和机构知识。这就像一个面向实验室的人工智能编译器，从意图到执行一站式搞定。这家公司来自 YC 春季 2026 批次，团队两人，虽然还没有融资，但产品概念很吸引人。

companies.name: Rimba
companies.originalOneLiner: Streamlining Data Capture to Report Creation for Heavy Industries
companies.originalDescription: Rimba integrates fragmented data — PDFs, Excel files, time-series, IoT sensors, equipment telemetry, and system performance data — to complete a workflow, such as populating a database, running analytics, and creating a report. Our software streamlines the entire journey from data capture to report creation for the physical world, starting with heavy industries such as renewables, oil & gas, supply chain, and chemicals. Legacy systems don't communicate, and critical operational data remains siloed. Rimba bridges that gap by connecting data from fragmented systems and structures — ERPs, SCADA, SharePoint, email, and more — to automate workflows, classify inputs, transform data, and improve data monitoring.
companies.story: 这家公司做的是重工业的数据到报告自动化。想象你是一家能源公司的运营分析师，每天要面对 PDF、Excel、传感器数据、设备遥测等一堆碎片信息，还要手动整理成报告。Rimba 把这些数据整合起来，自动完成从数据采集、分析到报告生成的全流程。它连接企业管理系统、监控系统、SharePoint 和邮件等不同系统，自动分类和转换数据，提升监控效率。这家公司来自 YC 春季 2025 批次，团队四人，专注于可再生能源、石油天然气、供应链和化工等行业。

companies.name: Speko
companies.originalOneLiner: YC S26) – OpenRouter for Voice AI
companies.originalDescription: YC S26) – OpenRouter for Voice AI
companies.story: 这家公司做的是语音人工智能的接口聚合平台，类似 OpenRouter 但专门针对语音。想象你是一位开发者，正在构建语音助手，但对接多家语音服务提供商非常麻烦，每家接口都不一样。Speko 提供一个统一接口，让你通过一个接口就能访问多家语音人工智能服务，简化集成过程。这家公司来自 YC 夏季 2026 批次，目前还没有更多信息，但方向很实用。

readings.title: What does an agentic SDLC actually look like?
readings.story: 当团队开始把人工智能代理引入软件开发流程，很多人会兴奋地想象一个全自动的未来。但真正的问题是，代理到底在哪个环节介入，才能不添乱反而提效？这篇文章来自Stack Overflow，它没有停留在概念层面，而是试图描绘一个具体的、可操作的代理化SDLC图景。读的时候，不妨留意作者如何区分哪些步骤适合交给代理，哪些还是需要人来拍板，这种取舍的智慧，往往比工具本身更重要。

readings.title: At least 62 YC startups with over $1.9B in funding are hosting on Replit
readings.story: 一个创业公司决定把产品托管在某个平台上，这本来是个内部技术决策。但当一个数据点变成“62家YC公司、19亿美元融资都选它”，它就成了一种信号：也许这个平台解决了早期团队共有的某个痛点，比如部署速度、成本或者易用性。这篇在Hacker News上被热议，正因为它触动了工程师和创始人的神经。读的时候，可以想想，为什么这些聪明团队会做出类似选择，背后是不是有一种新的默认路径正在形成。

readings.title: [AINews] Stripe buys OpenRouter for $7B
readings.story: 当一家支付巨头花70亿美元买下一个人工智能模型路由平台，这消息很容易被当成一则收购新闻划过。但如果你停下来想，Stripe为什么需要OpenRouter？它看中的可能不是技术本身，而是人工智能应用层正在变成一种需要“支付”的基础设施。这篇来自Latent Space的报道，或许能帮你理解这笔交易背后的产业逻辑。读的时候，试着关注作者如何从一笔收购推测出人工智能生态的走向，以及谁会是下一个受益者。

companies.name: Floracene
companies.originalOneLiner: Vibecode + deploy HIPAA-compliant internal tools, no eng team needed
companies.originalDescription: Floracene lets anyone at a medical practice describe the internal tool they need and deploy it in one click - connected to production data, with read and write access scoped by the user. Think Lovable or Retool, except purpose-built for the needs of a medical practice that has no engineering team. The bottleneck in healthcare isn't building anymore. Anyone can vibecode an 80% solution in an afternoon, custom to their own workflow, with people already on staff. The tool then dies locally on the builder’s computer, because IT (correctly) won't let anyone deploy a tool touching PHI without first-class authentication and permissioning. Our first design partner had multiple employees who had each built useful tools and dashboards locally, but couldn’t actually share these with coworkers or connect to their core practice data. Within weeks of implementing Floracene, they were able to cut a $12K / month contract for a crappy dashboarding tool and had 4 home-built tools shipped to production. ~$200B is spent on administrative software in healthcare every year in the US. Tens of thousands of those companies still run core operations on spreadsheets, and we're at the top of the first inning of AI adoption. Asaph and Jonah met on the hospitals team at Palantir two years ago, and have each spent the last four years in the plumbing of US healthcare: claims, eligibility, and payor contracting. Asaph was an early PM at Garner. Jonah was a founding engineer at Metriport (YC S22) after starting his own fax-automation startup for fertility clinics.
companies.story: 这是一家为医疗诊所打造内部工具部署平台的公司。想象你是诊所的运营负责人，同事用人工智能工具做出了能提高效率的表格或看板，却因为涉及患者隐私数据，信息技术部门不敢让这些工具真正上线，只能烂在个人电脑里。Floracene 让任何员工用自然语言描述需求，一键部署合规的内部工具，自动处理身份验证和权限控制，连接生产数据。这家公司来自 YC 夏季批次，团队只有两人，但已经帮助第一家合作诊所让员工自建的工具真正投入使用，解决了医疗行业长期存在的工具落地难题。

companies.name: Voltair
companies.originalOneLiner: Autonomous Drones for Earth Observation
companies.originalDescription: Voltair is building the world's first globally distributed network of autonomous drones for Earth observation. Power utilities are the perfect first customer. Aging infrastructure and extreme weather drive the need for millimeter-scale inspection data on the power grid. Utilities spend tens of billions of dollars every year just looking at their own equipment. Autonomous drone fleets will enable utilities to inspect 7 million miles of infrastructure more frequently, quickly, and accurately. Our long-range, weatherized flying robots work with charging pads installed directly on utility poles. Each new pad unlocks 1000 square miles of coverage. With a charging network deployed on the power grid, we can serve existing multi-billion dollar data markets in road, rail and telecom inspection at 10x lower prices while enabling entirely new applications in hyperlocal weather monitoring, forestry, construction, search & rescue, and insurance. We envision a future in which drone "instances" are requested on-demand through our platform, enabling any application builder to serve these critical markets without ever operating their own hardware.
companies.story: 这家公司做的是自主无人机地球观测网络。想象你是电力公司的巡检负责人，面对绵延数千公里的输电线路，传统人工巡检既慢又贵，还难以应对极端天气后的快速检查。Voltair 的无人机能长期在户外飞行，利用安装在电线杆上的充电底座，每增加一个底座就能覆盖一千平方英里的区域，让电网巡检更频繁、更准确。这家公司来自 YC 冬季批次，团队五人，正在招聘，瞄准的是每年数十亿美元的电力巡检市场，未来还能扩展到道路、铁路和电信设施的检测，甚至用于局部天气监测。

companies.name: Sentrial
companies.originalOneLiner: Datadog for Agent Reliability
companies.originalDescription: Sentrial is the monitoring platform for AI products in production. When your AI product/agent loops indefinitely, hallucinates, or frustrates users, Sentrial detects it in real-time, diagnoses the root cause, and recommends specific fixes. We provide the monitoring, evaluation, and debugging infrastructure that traditional tools weren't built for, so teams iterate based on production reality, not just offline evals.
companies.story: 这家公司做的是人工智能产品在生产环境中的监控平台。想象你是人工智能产品的运维工程师，智能体突然陷入死循环，或者开始胡说八道，用户抱怨不断，你却只能事后从日志里找原因。Sentrial 能实时检测这些问题，自动诊断根因，并给出修复建议，让团队基于生产环境的真实情况来迭代，而不是只依赖离线测试。这家公司来自 YC 冬季批次，团队两人，他们看到了传统监控工具在人工智能时代的空白，为那些已经上线的智能体提供可靠性保障。

companies.name: Tinfoil
companies.originalOneLiner: Encrypted AI with verifiable privacy
companies.originalDescription: Tinfoil makes it easy to make your AI workloads secure and provably private. You get the privacy of on-prem deployments, while running on the cloud. It's like end-to-end encrypted messaging but for your AI applications. We’ve built a full-stack platform on top of the latest NVIDIA GPUs offering confidential computing capabilities, meaning that you don’t have to trade off performance for privacy. We integrate a suite of recent advances in secure hardware technologies, in particular NVIDIA’s confidential compute mode available on Hopper and Blackwell. When combined with Tinfoil’s software stack, companies can prove their security claims like "we can't see and don’t log your queries.” Tinfoil guarantees that all data always stays private and cannot be accessed by anyone other than the end user -- not even by Tinfoil or the cloud provider it’s processed on. Everything can be made end-to-end encrypted and private with Tinfoil. The founding team combines deep academic and industry experience in security and Internet protocols. Tanya was previously a systems engineer at Cloudflare, where she built Internet security protocols used by billions, and contributed to the Workers AI platform. Jules and Sacha hold PhDs from MIT, where they worked on secure hardware, cryptography, and privacy technologies. Jules has also worked at NVIDIA on their confidential computing team. Tinfoil was born from our personal frustration with the false choice between access to powerful AI and the massive data privacy implications of deeply integrated AI. AI is a universal tool that becomes part of our personal lives and business workflows. In the process, it needs access to all personal, private, and proprietary data. Right now, the only solutions are data processing agreements (i.e., "pinky promises"), band-aids like PII redaction that don't work in practice, or AI locally/on-prem, which doesn't scale. Tinfoil promises to unlock significantly deeper AI adoption and integrations by making it easy to obtain true privacy, just as TLS on the Internet enabled e-commerce to flourish by securing credit cards on the network. Today we offer several self-serve products: - A consumer-facing chatbot that keeps your chats end-to-end encrypted and provides zero-access inference with powerful open-source models like Kimi, Gemma, and GLM. You can try it out for free: https://chat.tinfoil.sh - A developer-friendly API that allows you to build AI applications where all user data is kept private and we as the inference provider cannot see any of the prompts. Our SDKs make sure that all relevant security measures are checked for you before even sending a single byte of data. Learn more:https://docs.tinfoil.sh - An advanced confidential computing platform we call Tinfoil Containers that allows you to secure any Docker application. We make it easy to deploy your own logic and applications inside secure enclaves and prove to the world what code is running inside. This enables attested workloads and publicly verifiable privacy policies for sensitive applications. Learn more: https://tinfoil.sh/containers
companies.story: 这家公司做的是加密人工智能，让云上的人工智能计算可以验证隐私。想象你是金融公司的合规负责人，想用云端人工智能处理敏感数据，却担心云服务商能看到你的信息。Tinfoil 利用英伟达最新图形处理器的机密计算能力，让你在云上运行人工智能时，数据全程加密，连 Tinfoil 自己和云服务商都无法访问，还能向审计方证明这一点。这家公司来自 YC 春季批次，团队五人，他们让企业既能享受云的弹性，又能获得本地部署的隐私保护，适合对数据安全要求极高的行业。

companies.name: Decawork
companies.originalOneLiner: The Agent Control Plane for IT teams
companies.originalDescription: Decawork gives IT teams one place to deploy, govern and maintain the AI agents running across their company. Building internal AI tools and agents is getting easier. Turning them into company-owned systems is still hard. What follows is agent sprawl: deployment gets messy, agents go live with access to real systems and real data, and maintenance falls in the gap. IT can't see any of it, so it does the only two things it can: first ignore, then block. Ignoring piles up risk; blocking kills the productivity people just found. With Decawork, every agent ships one standard way: its own identity and scoped credentials, with IT's sign-off before it goes live. After that, every run is watched - IT is alerted the moment something fails, agents nobody uses get retired. And the whole time, IT sees every agent, controls what it can touch, and audits every action, with approvals gating anything sensitive. Every big shift - cloud, SaaS, the digital workspace - ended with IT running it. Agents aren't just the next shift, they're the next workforce, bigger than the human one. Decawork is what IT will run them with.
companies.story: 这家公司做的是企业人工智能智能体的管理平台。想象你是公司信息技术部门的负责人，各个团队都开始用人工智能工具，但这些智能体散落各处，有的权限过大，有的没人维护，你既看不见也管不住，只能要么放任风险，要么一刀切封锁。Decawork 给每个智能体一个统一的标准身份和权限，上线前需要信息技术部门审批，运行中全程监控，一旦出错立刻告警，还能自动淘汰没人用的智能体。这家公司来自 YC 夏季批次，团队两人，他们让信息技术部门从阻碍者变成智能体的治理者，解决智能体蔓延带来的混乱。

companies.name: Ruma Care
companies.originalOneLiner: The operations stack for biologic infusion clinics
companies.originalDescription: Ruma Care automates all admin work for infusion clinics - starting with prior authorizations & copay assistance enrollment. Biologics are expensive medications that cost $80-$150K+ per year per patient, and often need to be administered in specific settings called infusion clinics. Medical providers buy these drugs up front to secure pricing deals and safer inventory - they are reimbursed for the cost of the medications through the patients’ insurance. Current medical workflows aren't built for infusion clinics. Inventory, storage, transport, and billing is still managed through paper and excel spreadsheets. And because they’re so expensive, these specialty medications are denied by insurers at a rate of 37% each year. When they are denied, when workflows fail, or patients are infused before paperwork is cleared, providers don’t get reimbursed for the medication and are left covering the costs. Ruma Care solves this so clinics get paid, patients get treated faster, and care teams spend less time fighting forms. We do this in three ways: 1. For each medication, diagnosis, and insurance combination, Ruma extracts the submission criteria required to get the drug approved by insurers. 2. We pull out the correct forms, then automate the form-filling for prior authorizations. 3. Lastly, we enroll patients in copay assistance programs, all in one workflow and platform. We turn a process that traditionally spans 70+ online portals, disparate paper forms, and manual phone calling into a single, streamlined platform. As we process prior authorizations, our models learn from denial patterns to understand exactly what insurers need to see to get a prior authorization approved.
companies.story: 这家公司做的是生物制剂输注诊所的运营管理软件。想象你是诊所的财务主管，每天要处理大量昂贵药物的预先授权和患者自付费用申请，这些药物每年每人花费八万到十五万美元，保险公司拒绝率高达百分之三十七，一旦流程出错，诊所就得自己承担药费。Ruma Care 自动化这些繁琐的文书工作，从预先授权到共付额援助申请，减少拒付和收入损失。这家公司来自 YC 冬季批次，团队两人，正在招聘，他们瞄准的是医疗系统中一个被忽视但成本高昂的环节，用软件提升效率。

companies.name: Novoflow
companies.originalOneLiner: AI employees that automate medical operations for clinics.
companies.originalDescription: Novoflow is building AI employees that automate medical operations for clinics. Novoflow built the universal bridge into EHR systems—so every workflow, from scheduling to billing, can finally run on AI. The first product is an AI employee that talks to patients and uses computer agents to book, reschedule, and recover cancelled appointments. Built for healthcare providers and hospitals.
companies.story: 这家公司做的是诊所的人工智能员工，可以自动处理预约等日常运营。想象你是诊所的接待员，每天要接听大量电话，安排和调整预约，还要处理患者爽约后的空档。Novoflow 的人工智能员工能直接与患者对话，并像人一样操作电脑系统，自动完成预约、改期和填补取消的号源。这家公司来自 YC 春季批次，团队六人，正在招聘，他们打通了与电子健康档案系统的连接，让人工智能真正融入诊所的日常工作流。

companies.name: Kita
companies.originalOneLiner: Automate credit assessment for lenders in emerging markets
companies.originalDescription: In emerging markets, open finance is still nascent. Most of the population is traditionally unbanked, banking APIs don’t exist, and a borrower’s financial history lives in documents: e-wallet records, bank statements, utility bills, and more. Because this data is unstructured, credit and risk teams are forced into manual review. This slows decisioning, increases costs, and caps lending volume. Kita is the AI platform for global lending operations. We help lenders in emerging markets automate application completion, document verification, and underwriting from messy financial documents — using AI to extract fraud-checked data and localized risk signals that power faster, better credit decisions. Under the hood, Kita is a learning engine. We link document-level signals to repayment outcomes, allowing our models to continuously improve fraud detection and risk assessment over time. This creates a compounding advantage for lenders as their distinct underwriting decisions feed back into the system. We’re Carmel and Rhea. We met before Stanford and have been building together ever since. Carmel is from Manila, is a repeat founder, and spent three years in product at Apple. Rhea has a research background in computer vision and received the highest honor in Stanford Computer Science. Together, we combine deep local context with strong technical execution to build the infrastructure that expands access to credit in emerging markets.
companies.story: 这家公司做的是新兴市场贷款机构的信用评估自动化。想象你是新兴市场银行的风控分析师，面对一堆杂乱的电子钱包记录、银行流水和账单，没有标准化的接口，只能靠人工逐份审核，放款慢且成本高。Kita 用人工智能从这些非结构化文档中提取数据，自动完成申请填写、文件验证和信用评估，还能将文档信号与还款结果关联，不断优化风控模型。这家公司来自 YC 冬季批次，团队三人，他们瞄准的是那些缺乏开放银行基础设施的市场，帮助贷款机构扩大业务。

companies.name: antimattr
companies.originalOneLiner: voice-first hardware interface for human-agent interaction
companies.originalDescription: antimattr builds a voice-first hardware interface for human-agent interaction that includes a ring and a pair of earphones. Designed to make more of your voice, the ring can record and summarise your conversations, capture thoughts on the go, or control your agents. The earphones use proprietary voice isolation technology to block out background noise entirely, so you can take a clear call from a loud pub or dictate with real accuracy. Reserve early access at https://www.antimattr.one/project-mnemosyne [use code YC at checkout]
companies.story: 这家公司做的是语音优先的硬件设备，让人与人工智能智能体的交互更自然。想象你是一个经常开会的人，想要记录对话、随时捕捉想法，但用手机录音整理很麻烦，在嘈杂环境中打电话也听不清。antimattr 推出了一枚戒指和一副耳机，戒指可以录音、总结对话、控制智能体，耳机则用专有语音隔离技术，让你在喧闹的酒吧也能清晰通话。这家公司来自 YC 秋季批次，团队两人，他们不只是一个手机应用，而是把语音交互能力放进随身佩戴的硬件里，让智能体随时可用。

companies.name: Boost Robotics
companies.originalOneLiner: Robots for the inspection and maintenance of data centers
companies.originalDescription: Boost Robotics is building autonomous mobile manipulation robots to remotely perform manual tasks in data centers. The surge in AI applications is pushing data centers to scale faster than they can manage, leading to suboptimal operations and staffing shortages amid rising power and compute demands. We save data centers millions in insurance premiums and SLA violations by increasing the frequency of inspection and maintenance while reducing the time it takes to triage and address failures.
companies.story: 这家公司做的是数据中心巡检和维护机器人。想象你是数据中心运营经理，面对快速扩张的服务器集群，人工巡检频率跟不上，故障排查耗时，还面临保险费用和合同罚款的压力。Boost Robotics 的自主移动操作机器人能远程执行人工任务，提高巡检和维护频率，缩短故障响应时间。这家公司来自 YC 春季批次，团队两人，他们针对人工智能时代数据中心规模激增的痛点，用机器人缓解人力短缺，节省保险和违约成本。

readings.title: Heavy Bluesky outage in the past day
readings.story: 有时候你正在刷着社交网络，突然发现页面转圈，刷新也没用，然后你下意识去查状态页，发现一片红。这种时刻在技术圈里特别容易引发讨论，因为大家不只是想知道什么时候恢复，更想猜背后是什么原因，是流量太猛，还是架构哪里撑不住了。这篇被大家转来转去的帖子，正好提供了一个切入口。你读的时候，不妨留意一下讨论里那些有经验的工程师是怎么推断的，他们关注哪些指标，又怎么区分偶发问题和系统性的瓶颈。

readings.title: Stripe will reportedly acquire AI gateway startup OpenRouter for $7B+
readings.story: 如果你平时留意科技新闻，可能已经注意到，最近大公司收购人工智能相关的小公司越来越频繁，金额也高得吓人。这次传出的消息是，Stripe打算花七十多亿美元买下OpenRouter，一个做人工智能网关的创业公司。你可能不太熟悉网关是什么，简单说，它就像是一个中转站，帮开发者统一接不同的大模型，不用一个个去对接。读这篇报道的时候，你可以想想，为什么支付公司会看中这样一个中间层，它到底卡住了什么痛点，收购之后，对使用人工智能服务的开发者来说，又会有什么变化。

readings.title: The 0% Quota Club (And Why the Same Mediocre Rep Hits 70% at One Company and 0% at Yours)
readings.story: 销售这个行当，最让人困惑的事情之一，就是同一个销售，换一家公司，业绩可能天差地别。你可能会想，是不是运气，或者产品本身不行，但很多时候，问题出在公司怎么定目标、怎么给资源、怎么带人。这篇文章就聊了聊这个现象，为什么有人在你这里是零，到别家却能完成七成。它不是要教你话术，而是想帮你看看，是不是你的销售流程、激励方式，或者客户定位出了问题。读的时候，你可以对照自己的团队，看看有没有类似的情况，也许答案就藏在那些你习以为常的管理细节里。

companies.name: Cumulus Labs
companies.originalOneLiner: The Fastest Multimodal Inference OS
companies.originalDescription: Cumulus Labs lets engineering teams ship AI in production without needing a dedicated ML platform team. Right now, companies building AI products are forced to stitch together separate vendors for routing, observability, evaluation, fine-tuning, and inference. This fragmented approach is brittle, expensive, and is a common reason enterprises fail with AI. We replace that entire stack with a single unified platform. Developers can keep their existing code while instantly upgrading to a unified platform that handles routing, semantic caching, continuous shadow evaluation, simulated data, and one-click fine-tuning. Behind the platform is Ion, our proprietary inference engine running on a custom NVIDIA Grace GPU fleet. Ion uses in-house custom GPU kernels to deliver 30 to 50 percent more throughput than standard vLLM or SGLang, giving our customers SOTA inference economics.
companies.story: 这是一家做人工智能推理基础设施的公司，目标是让工程团队不用专门搭建机器学习平台就能把人工智能产品带到生产环境。想象你是一家创业公司的后端负责人，过去几个月为了上线一个人工智能功能，你要在好几个供应商之间来回切换，处理路由、监控、评估、微调这些琐碎环节，系统又慢又贵，还经常出问题。这家公司用一个统一平台替换掉整套碎片化工具，你原有的代码不用改就能直接升级。平台背后是自研的推理引擎，跑在定制的英伟达算力集群上，靠自研的图形处理器内核，吞吐量比常见的开源方案高百分之三十到五十。值得关注的是它来自 YC 冬季批次，团队只有两个人但正在招人，说明他们正处在快速扩张的早期阶段。

companies.name: Robby
companies.originalOneLiner: AI agents that grow revenue for home services businesses
companies.originalDescription: Robby is an AI growth engine for home services businesses that uncovers revenue opportunities and collects additional data from every technician visit. Our AI combines customer and third party data to generate dozens of new leads every day, and then arms the technicians with talking points to increase close rates, giving GMs a single command center to manage and drive revenue. We have several paying customers that are each uncovering 6 figures in additional revenue opportunities every week. On our first day of launch, we helped close $40k in new business within an hour. Our team has spent the last few months riding along with dozens of technicians and shadowing every position in the office to best understand the industry. We're also studying for the EPA 608 exam to become certified technicians ourselves. Vineet and Feroze have both built critical products and infra at prominent startups (Ironclad, Porter, Affinity, Uber, Cloud Health Systems). Joe previously consulted PE firms on software acquisitions and led home services growth projects at Bain. We all met at Harvard Business School, and dropped out to work on Robby full-time.
companies.story: 这家公司做的是家居服务行业的人工智能增长引擎，专门帮水管、电工这类上门服务生意挖掘更多收入。想象你是一家连锁家政服务公司的运营经理，每天最头疼的是技师上门后只做了眼前那单活，明明客户家里还有其他需求，却没人跟进，白白浪费商机。这家公司的智能体会把客户数据和外部信息结合起来，每天自动生成几十条新销售线索，技师出发前手机上就能看到针对这位客户的谈话要点，成交率自然就上去了。目前已有付费客户，每周能发现六位数金额的额外收入机会，上线第一天就帮客户在一小时内成交了四万美元新业务。团队为了真正理解行业，亲自跟车几十位技师，还去考制冷技师执照，这种接地气的做法在 YC 冬季批次里显得很扎实。

companies.name: Origami Robotics
companies.originalOneLiner: Manipulate Anything Robot
companies.originalDescription: We are building a "manipulate anything" model with the robot hardware that embodies it. We designed a hand-based data-collection device and a high DOF, direct drive robotic hand that match each other exactly, enabling us to eliminate embodiment gap and collect real-world data and deploy it directly. We want to scale real world manipulation data by deploying our devices "in the wild" like manufacturing factories, logistic centers to collect Tesla like data, use these data to train our model and then provide automation solutions to these industries.
companies.story: 这是一家做机器人的公司，目标是造出能操作任何物体的机器人和配套模型。传统机器人只能在固定工位重复同一个动作，换个零件就得重新编程。想象你是一家汽车工厂的自动化主管，装配线上新来了一批形状不规则的零部件，现有的机械臂根本抓不稳，你正愁要不要花几十万买新设备。这家公司设计了一款高自由度直驱机械手，还配套了完全匹配的数据采集设备，消除了训练和实际部署之间的差距，采集的数据能直接用来训练模型。他们计划把采集设备部署到工厂和物流中心，像特斯拉那样大量收集真实操作数据，再反过来提供自动化方案。团队五个人来自 YC 冬季批次，虽然还没开始招聘，但硬件加数据飞轮的思路值得关注。

companies.name: Context.dev
companies.originalOneLiner: We give AI agents realtime web context.
companies.originalDescription: Context.dev gives AI agents structured data from any website through a single API. We help developers build smarter agents & products that depend on accurate, fresh web data. If you need structured data from the internet, you need Context.dev Proud to power agentic products at Mintlify, Super, Vizzy, Klarna, and 400+ other companies.
companies.story: 这家公司做的是给智能体提供实时网页数据的接口服务，一句话说就是让机器能看懂任何网站。想象你是一个正在开发购物比价助手的工程师，你的智能体需要知道商品价格、库存这些实时信息，但网站结构天天变，写爬虫又慢又容易挂，你恨不得把电脑扔出窗外。这家公司把全网网页转成结构化数据，通过一个接口就能拿到，省去你维护爬虫的功夫。目前已经服务了包括 Klarna 在内的四百多家公司，很多知名产品都在用。创始人一个人撑起这家公司，来自 YC 夏季批次，虽然人手少但客户名单很有说服力，说明这个需求是真实存在的。

companies.name: Mount
companies.originalOneLiner: The AI Agent Insurance Carrier
companies.originalDescription: TLDR: Mount is building the AI insurance carrier, starting with liability coverage for deployed AI agents. As everyone moves AI Agents into production and gives them more responsibility, we help businesses insure and secure them. Whenever responsibility shifts from human operators to autonomous systems, so too does the liability that accompanies it. The systems also introduce new risks: agentic software failures, prompt injection attacks, autonomous workflow errors, data leaks, and more. Legacy insurance was not built for this. Existing policies are often silent, ambiguous, or exclude autonomous software, and traditional insurers lack the data and technical capability to assess deployed AI Systems. Our first product, the Mount AI Liability Policy, is built for mid-market and enterprise companies deploying autonomous AI agents in real business processes. We scan and red-team AI deployments, quantify operational risk, help fix vulnerabilities, and insure the residual risk with purpose-built AI liability coverage. Mount is best thought of as a highly automated version of today's commercial insurance carriers, which run on manual workflows, layers of intermediaries, and tens of thousands of employees. AI enables automation of underwriting, pricing, policy issuance, claims, fraud detection, customer support, and distribution. We believe that the best way to use this opportunity is to rebuild those processes from the ground up.
companies.story: 这是一家做人工智能保险的公司，专门为部署在真实业务里的智能体提供责任险。想象你是一家物流公司的风控负责人，公司刚把智能调度系统接入仓库，结果它一次误操作导致货品损坏，你翻遍保单发现传统保险条款里根本没写清楚人工智能造成损失算不算数。这家公司就是来解决这个空白的，他们先扫描你的智能体部署情况，做红队测试找出漏洞，再给出量身定制的保单。传统保险公司既没数据也没技术能力评估人工智能系统，而这家公司来自 YC 春季批次，团队两人，产品刚起步，正好踩在智能体大规模落地带来的新风险上，值得关注。

companies.name: Kimpton AI
companies.originalOneLiner: The IDE for Investors
companies.originalDescription: In investment management, the final outcome isn't a deck or a memo. It's the trade. Kimpton is the AI-native research platform for portfolio managers. We're commoditizing the research layer and handing PMs data distilled into structured trades. The whole industry is fighting underperformance. Active managers trail their benchmarks, and capital keeps bleeding into passive. AI was supposed to fix that, but it hasn't. Funds either stitch together a dozen point tools or babysit general agents all day, and neither gets them to the trade. Kimpton goes straight to it. It ingests a fund's mandate, strategy, and positions. It runs them through our own harness and returns a structured trade proposal built for that fund. It connects to any institutional data source they already run on. And it's built to disagree, because consensus is poison for investment decisions. Instead of telling a PM what they want to hear, it surfaces the breaches and risks they'd otherwise miss. We're two ex-Goldman engineers and an ex-SpaceX engineer. We left to start our own quantitative systematic hedge fund. We raised $10M from a family office at 21 and 22, and scaled it to $35M over four years. We built Kimpton inside that fund, then productized the stack. We're live with our first institutional client, a $3.3B manager, and our first market is fundamental equity funds from $1B to $10B. Humans make the decisions. Kimpton does everything else.
companies.story: 这家公司做的是面向投资经理的人工智能研究平台，把研究过程直接变成交易建议。想象你是一位掌管几十亿资金的基金经理，每天被各种研报和模型淹没，团队花几周做的分析，结果跑输大盘，你急需一个能直接告诉你该买什么卖什么的工具。这家平台会读取你的基金授权、策略和持仓，跑一遍内部模型，直接输出一份结构化交易提案，还能接入你现有的数据源。它刻意设计成会反驳你的观点，因为投资决策最怕人云亦云。整个行业都在跑输被动指数，资金不断流出，这家公司想用人工智能把研究层商品化，让经理直接拿到交易结果。来自 YC 春季批次，团队五人，方向很聚焦。

companies.name: Scheduling Wizard
companies.originalOneLiner: Logistics infrastructure to modernize healthcare operations
companies.originalDescription: Scheduling Wizard is building the logistics infrastructure to modernize healthcare operations. Hospitals still rely on manual workflows to manage staffing, patient flow, and core operations, contributing to $760B in annual inefficiency. 20 departments across 16 hospitals already outsource their physician scheduling to us, powered by our internal Scheduling Programming Language and AI-driven workflows. We work with Mass General, Johns Hopkins, UT Southwestern, UCSF, and many others. We are actively onboarding new clients and expanding into patient triaging and provider management systems, working with partner departments at UCSF and other leading institutions. Scheduling Wizard aims to bring healthcare operations into the future by reducing administrative burden and improving clinical care coordination. Our goal is to create the AI-native administrative layer in healthcare operations.
companies.story: 这是一家做医疗后勤基础设施的公司，帮医院把医生排班这类核心运营工作从手工表格里解放出来。想象你是一家三甲医院的运营负责人，每个月要协调几十位医生的值班安排，考虑休假、手术、门诊各种冲突，每次排班都要熬几个通宵，还总有医生抱怨。这家公司用自研的排班编程语言和人工智能工作流，把这件事自动化了。目前已经有十六家医院的二十个科室在用它排班，包括麻省总医院、约翰霍普金斯这些顶级机构。团队三人来自 YC 冬季批次，正在拓展病人分诊和供应商管理系统，目标是成为医疗运营的人工智能原生管理层，减少行政负担，让医生更专注看病。

companies.name: Ultrasonium
companies.originalOneLiner: Manufacturing the metal parts the world runs on faster, cheaper, safer
companies.originalDescription: The technologies that define this century, including data centers, rockets, satellites, and robots, are built from complex metal parts. As these systems advance, the parts get harder to make. Past a certain complexity, casting and machining stop working, and the advanced methods that remain are slow, expensive, and hazardous. Ultrasonium has invented a new manufacturing method to make these critical parts 15x faster and 75% cheaper than the methods they replace, in the U.S. and at scale. Solid metal feedstock goes in and a finished part safely comes out, controlled by a physical AI layer and novel control processes. The systems that matter most, in aerospace, energy, and compute, are demanding metal geometries that can't be machined or cast and are too expensive and slow to make with incumbent methods, at a moment when domestic manufacturing capacity is a national priority. Our founding team has built and innovated some of the most complex engineering systems known to man: quantum computers, superconductors, nuclear reactors, and novel aerospace alloy processing methods.
companies.story: 这是一家做先进金属零件制造的公司，发明了一种全新的生产方法，比现有工艺快十五倍还便宜四分之三。想象你是一家航天公司的制造工程师，火箭发动机里有个形状极其复杂的喷嘴，用机床加工要几周，铸造又做不出那个精度，你正卡在项目进度上。这家公司把实心金属料放进去，出来就是成品零件，全程由物理人工智能层控制，不需要危险的模具或切削液。数据中心、火箭、卫星这些尖端设备对复杂金属件的需求越来越大，传统方法要么做不了要么太贵，而这家公司在美国本土就能规模化生产。团队十七人来自 YC 夏季批次，规模不小，制造方法属于硬科技突破，值得关注。

companies.name: Alt-X
companies.originalOneLiner: Building the best venue for private markets exposure.
companies.originalDescription: Alt-X is building the AI-native liquidity layer for private markets. Private markets have created trillions of dollars in value, yet remain fragmented, illiquid, and inaccessible. While public markets benefit from exchanges, market makers, brokerages, and data infrastructure, private markets still rely on brokers, spreadsheets, and manual workflows to connect buyers and sellers. Alt-X uses AI to automate the core functions required to make private assets liquid. We streamline diligence, valuation, investor matching, and transaction execution, reducing the friction that makes private-market transactions slow, expensive, and opaque today. Our initial focus is venture-backed secondaries. We source opportunities from founders, employees, and early investors while building a network of accredited investors seeking exposure to the world's most valuable private companies. Over time, we believe every private asset—from startup equity to private credit and alternative investments—will require modern liquidity infrastructure. Building trusted infrastructure for private markets is difficult. Transactions involve complex diligence, fragmented information, transfer restrictions, and significant compliance requirements. Alt-X is focused on creating systems that can support real transactions at scale, not just marketplace listings. Ryan Samadi (Stanford CS/AI, former Citadel commodities trader) and Michael Wachsman (Cornell CS, infrastructure engineer) are building Alt-X because they believe ownership of innovation should be more liquid, transparent, and accessible. Today, Alt-X has sourced over $1.5 million in transaction opportunities and assembled a network of 40 accredited investors representing hundreds of millions of dollars in investable assets. Our mission is to democratize ownership of innovation by building the financial infrastructure that private markets have never had.
companies.story: 这是一家做私募市场流动性平台的公司，用人工智能让买卖未上市公司的股份变得像股票交易一样顺畅。想象你是一家初创公司的早期员工，公司估值涨了很多，但你手里的期权要等上市才能变现，你急需用钱却找不到买家，只能干着急。这家平台用人工智能自动化尽职调查、估值、匹配买家和执行交易，让私募股权交易不再依赖券商和电子表格。他们先从风险投资支持的二手份额入手，从创始人、员工和早期投资人那里找机会，同时建一个合格投资者网络。团队两人来自 YC 冬季批次，方向是填补私募市场基础设施空白，值得关注。

companies.name: Lambda Robotics
companies.originalOneLiner: Robotics for AI Infrastructure
companies.originalDescription: Lambda Robotics builds and deploys robots for the infrastructure powering frontier AI.
companies.story: 这是一家做机器人的公司，专门为前沿人工智能的算力基础设施建造和维护机器人。想象你是一个大型数据中心的运维主管，几千个服务器机柜里全是发热的图形处理器，人工巡检又慢又危险，你正愁怎么提高维护效率。这家公司造的机器人能在数据中心里自主移动，完成设备检查、零部件更换这些工作，让基础设施运维不再依赖人工。团队六人来自 YC 秋季批次，正在招聘，方向是把机器人技术用在人工智能最吃紧的算力环节上，属于基础设施层面的创新，值得关注。

readings.title: Woman claims her stepfather used Grok to transform childhood photo into explicit imagery
readings.story: 当一张普通的童年照片被技术改写成完全不同的东西，很多人第一反应是愤怒，但紧接着会困惑：这到底是怎么发生的？工具本身没有恶意，可它一旦落入错误的人手里，就可能变成伤害的载体。这篇报道讲的正是这样一个具体事件，它把抽象的人工智能风险拉回到真实生活里。读的时候，不妨留意作者是如何梳理责任链条的，是归咎于工具、平台，还是使用者，以及他如何呈现受害者一方的处境。这样的视角，能帮我们更清醒地看待身边那些越来越强大的图像生成技术。

readings.title: 🧠 Community Wisdom: Recovering from burnout, what Airtable’s sale says about the ceiling on a startup, keeping architecture docs up to date, running competitor analysis, and more
readings.story: 创业公司里总有那么些问题，平时不起眼，但一旦撞上，就会让人卡住好几天。比如团队里有人累垮了，比如产品做到一半发现方向错了，又比如文档没人更新，最后谁也看不懂。这些问题散落在各个角落，单独看都不大，但合在一起就构成了日常的琐碎消耗。这篇社区问答合集，把这类问题集中摆了出来，每个都是过来人真实踩过的坑。读的时候，不用急着找答案，先看看他们是怎么描述问题的，那种描述本身，往往比建议更有启发。

readings.title: Gamma’s CEO: Why Getting to $100M ARR Without A Sales Team Worked. And Why It Was a Mistake.
readings.story: 很多创业者都幻想过这样一个场景：产品足够好，用户自己会来，不用销售也能做到几亿收入。但真有人做到之后，回头却说这是个错误。这种反差本身就值得琢磨。这家公司的CEO在访谈里复盘了那段经历，讲清楚为什么没有销售团队也能增长，又为什么后来发现这条路走不通。读的时候，重点看他怎么区分“当时有效”和“长期正确”这两件事，以及他是在哪个节点意识到问题的。这种复盘，比那些一味鼓吹增长的故事要实在得多。

companies.name: Cyberdesk
companies.originalOneLiner: Self learning computer use agent for developers
companies.originalDescription: Cyberdesk is the first self learning computer use agent for developers to automate desktop workflows. For example, one of our customers is building an AI agent for hospital patient intake, and they’re using us to automate an entire team of people manually clicking and typing into a desktop app to book appointments. We launched mid July, and our agent is already operating in production environments, creating appointments in electronic health record apps and processing files in legacy ERPs. We’ve built the first computer use agent that memorizes tasks and repeats them quickly while still adapting to unexpected changes on the screen. A good analogy is to how humans use computers: once we get used to an app, we use it much faster, while still adapting to random popups and crashes. This new paradigm for computer use will be needed by every company automating human workflows on computers. Mahmoud previously built robotic process automation solutions impacting 20K+ employees at a Fortune 100 company. He also built AI & ML solutions at Baylor College of Medicine Neuroscience & Texas Children's Hospital + co-published a paper at the Rice Networks Group. Alan is ex-NASA and previously dropped out to be the first founding engineer at a PearX startup. He is a second time founder, having previously built and scaled a consumer AI app to thousands of paying users. Computer-use agents will automate the $6T dollars spent on enterprise knowledge work and Cyberdesk will be the platform to power this. We’d love to talk with you! https://cal.com/mahmoud-al-madi-klrs5s/30min
companies.story: Cyberdesk 是一家面向开发者的智能体公司，它让电脑操作自动化变得更聪明。想象你是一名软件工程师，正在为医院搭建一个病人登记系统，但每天都要手动在桌面应用里点击和输入，重复又耗时。Cyberdesk 的智能体能记住这些操作并自动执行，还能适应屏幕上的意外变化，比如弹窗或崩溃。它已经在上线环境中运行，比如自动在电子健康记录应用里创建预约，或在老式企业管理系统里处理文件。这家公司来自 YC 夏季 2025 批次，团队两人，产品刚发布就已在生产环境使用，值得关注。

companies.name: DeepReach Inc.
companies.originalOneLiner: Real-world data network for robots & world models
companies.originalDescription: Physical AI — robots and world models — is bottlenecked on one thing: diverse, real-world data at massive scale showing how humans actually do work in the physical world. It was never written down, and you can't buy it, because no one has ever captured it. Only real local experts, the people who do this work every day, can produce data this authentic and valuable. DeepReach builds the network that reaches them. We design and manufacture wearable stereo capture devices, then place them with local data partners who run collection as their own business — in warehouses, workshops, farms, kitchens and repair shops. They own the local relationships; we supply the hardware, the software platform, the quality pipeline and the payments. Anyone can run a data business. That structure is what produces diversity. Instead of thousands of hours inside one environment, we deliver hours spread across thousands of environments — which is what actually makes robot policies generalize. 475 devices in the field and 100+ data partners are live across 7 countries, adding new partners every week. They've collected nearly 150,000 clips in the past three months, with volume roughly doubling month over month. Our data is in production with multiple frontier model and robotics companies, and we're scaling to 10,000+ devices across 50 countries.
companies.story: DeepReach 做的是机器人和世界模型的数据网络，核心是采集真实世界的操作数据。想象你是一家仓库的主管，每天都有大量搬运工作，而机器人需要学习这些动作才能替代人力。DeepReach 设计并制造可穿戴的立体捕捉设备，交给本地数据伙伴，让他们在仓库、车间、农场等地采集数据。这些数据多样且真实，是训练机器人的关键。公司来自 YC 夏季 2026 批次，团队六人，正在搭建这个网络，值得关注。

companies.name: Hubble
companies.originalOneLiner: The intelligence layer for patient information
companies.originalDescription: Hubble retrieves complete medical records on behalf of patients using patient-mediated access. Under a patient's HIPAA right of access, they authorize us once and we pull their full history from every provider they've seen (hospitals, clinics, labs, imaging centers), no per-provider integration or IT project required. Getting records today still runs on faxes, patient portals, and release-of-information queues, so teams that need medical data wait weeks and get back a pile of unstructured PDFs. Hubble handles the retrieval end to end and returns clean, structured records, turning what used to take weeks into days. We work with teams that live or die on getting patient records fast: legal (personal injury, mass tort, disability), life sciences and research, and anyone building products that need a patient's real medical history to work. Instead of standing up records infrastructure themselves, they use Hubble as the retrieval layer. We're the team behind the AI agents at Grow Therapy and Amazon's One Medical used by millions of patients (Prabha was Grow's first PM building their AI agents, Aaron built the AI infra serving 1M+ clients).
companies.story: Hubble 是医疗信息领域的公司，它帮助患者获取完整的医疗记录。想象你是一名律师，正在处理一个人身伤害案件，需要快速拿到客户的病历，但传统方式要等几周，还都是杂乱的 PDF。Hubble 利用患者的合法访问权，一次性从所有就诊过的医院、诊所、实验室拉取完整历史，并整理成结构化数据，把几周缩短到几天。这家公司来自 YC 夏季 2026 批次，团队两人，专注于解决医疗数据获取的痛点，值得关注。

companies.name: Klaimee
companies.originalOneLiner: Liability insurance for AI Agents. You deploy agents, we cover you.
companies.originalDescription: Klaimee is the first insurance for your AI agents. It covers what traditional E&O and cyber explicitly carve out, so you can deploy agentic AI at scale with real peace of mind. Built for companies deploying agentic AI, self-serve from day one. The problem: AI agents are taking actions autonomously buying, emailing, modifying sensitive data. AB 316 already holds deployers liable. EU AI Act enforces in August. Cyber and E&O insurance are excluding AI claims. Companies shipping agents have zero coverage and no third-party proof their agent is safe. Enterprise legal asks "who pays if your agent breaks something?" and there's no good answer. We built the answer. Critical-category risk evaluation, certification, financial guarantee, liability insurance and the documentation enterprise procurement needs to sign off. Team: Ines (ex-General Manager at SafetyWing, grew insurance product from $5M to $60M revenue, 5 years launching insurance products from scratch and structuring a TokioMarine MGA into its own carrier) + Julien (AI software engineer + corporate strategy, enterprise compliance). We understand how insurance works, what enterprises require, and why startups can't wait 6 months for either.
companies.story: Klaimee 做的是人工智能智能体的责任保险，这是保险行业的新方向。想象你是一家公司的法务负责人，公司准备部署一个人工智能智能体来自动处理客户邮件，但你担心它出错造成损失，而传统保险又不覆盖这类风险。Klaimee 提供专门的保险，涵盖智能体自主行动可能造成的损害，并提供风险评估和认证，让企业能安心部署。公司来自 YC 春季 2026 批次，正在招聘，团队两人，创始人有保险行业经验，值得关注。

companies.name: Chasi
companies.originalOneLiner: AI Revenue Engine for the Equipment Industry
companies.originalDescription: Chasi deploys AI agents that help equipment dealers sell more, respond faster, and maximize fleet utilization - 24/7. One-third of the cost to build and maintain the physical world goes to equipment, yet fleet utilization across the industry often sits below 60%. Billions in assets sit idle while dealers drown in phone calls, emails, and manual data entry. Missed quotes, slow follow-ups, and disconnected systems mean lost revenue every day. Chasi plugs into a dealer's existing stack to deploy AI agents that handle sales, rentals, and service requests around the clock. The result: faster response times, higher utilization, and stronger margins, without adding headcount. We automate the busywork so teams can focus on what actually grows the business: customer relationships. Akash Pavan and Sarman Aulakh have built tractors, race cars, and robots, and previously led AI deployments at Tesla, Boeing, and Cummins, where they saw firsthand how much operational value gets left on the table in equipment-heavy industries. Chasi is live across equipment businesses in the US and Europe.
companies.story: Chasi 为设备行业提供人工智能销售引擎，帮助经销商提升销售和利用率。想象你是一家工程机械经销商的销售经理，每天要接大量电话、回邮件、手动录入数据，但设备利用率却不到六成。Chasi 的智能体能自动处理销售、租赁和服务请求，快速响应客户，提高设备利用率，同时减轻团队负担。公司来自 YC 冬季 2026 批次，正在招聘，团队两人，创始人曾在特斯拉领导人工智能部署，有硬件背景，值得关注。

companies.name: Revise Robotics
companies.originalOneLiner: Automating refurbishment of $1T in consumer electronics
companies.originalDescription: E-waste recycling facilities spend most of their time and effort sifting through discarded electronics, searching for valuable devices, refurbishing them, and reselling them in second-hand markets. Our first product is an AI-enabled robotic system that integrates with these facilities to assess and refurbish hundreds of laptops a day without any human intervention. The system tests laptops, wipes their hard drives, photographs them, and posts them on online marketplaces for resale, regardless of model, manufacturer, or operating system.
companies.story: Revise Robotics 用机器人自动化电子产品的翻新过程，切入的是电子垃圾回收行业。想象你是一家回收厂的运营经理，每天要人工分拣、测试、翻新大量旧笔记本电脑，效率低且成本高。Revise Robotics 的机器人系统能自动测试、擦除硬盘、拍照并上架到二手市场，每天处理数百台设备，无需人工干预。公司来自 YC 冬季 2025 批次，正在招聘，团队三人，产品已在实际设施中应用，值得关注。

companies.name: CellType
companies.originalOneLiner: The agentic drug company. We simulate human biology.
companies.originalDescription: CellType is building an agentic drug company. AI agents that run the full drug discovery pipeline on top of biological foundation models that simulate human biology. Our core technology, developed with Google DeepMind, has already discovered and validated a new cancer treatment signal. We’re working with Top 10 pharma.
companies.story: CellType 是一家用人工智能智能体模拟人类生物学的新药研发公司。想象你是一名药物研发科学家，传统方法需要数年才能筛选出候选药物，而 CellType 的智能体可以在模拟环境中快速运行整个研发流程。核心技术与 Google DeepMind 合作开发，已经发现并验证了一个新的癌症治疗信号，并与前十大制药公司合作。公司来自 YC 冬季 2026 批次，正在招聘，团队两人，值得关注。

companies.name: Agency Tool Company
companies.originalOneLiner: Reliable infrastructure to build, deploy and manage real-world robots.
companies.originalDescription: Agency Tool Company ships software to robots in the field 20x faster than a Docker pull with ATC Deploy, sending only the bytes that changed and resuming when the network drops. Deployment tooling is the connection between the lab & the field that continually bottlenecks robotics scaling and lacks a strong robotics-native solution. Deploy is live today with 3 launch partners across ag, construction, and logistics robotics. Our second product, ATC Build, offers embedded-compute as a CI service so devs can run tests and validate their software on the actual target hardware. Build supports the Nvidia Jetson lineup, Raspberry Pi, and a number of other embedded platform targets. Jack Morrison and Davis Foster founded and sold Scythe Robotics after deploying hundreds of autonomous mowers across the country; Agency Tool Company is building the robotics deployment platform across hardware and software they wish they had. Learn more at https://agencytool.com
companies.story: Agency Tool Company 为现实世界机器人提供可靠的软件部署工具。想象你是一家农业机器人公司的工程负责人，需要将软件更新部署到田间地头的机器人上，但网络不稳定，传统方式又慢又容易失败。ATC Deploy 只发送变更部分，断点续传，比 Docker 拉取快 20 倍。公司已有三个启动合作伙伴，覆盖农业、建筑和物流。创始人曾创立 Scythe Robotics 并成功出售，这次从 YC 夏季 2026 批次出来，团队三人，值得关注。

companies.name: Pelica
companies.originalOneLiner: Transforming healthcare operations with AI agents
companies.originalDescription: Pelica is the AI-native operating system for value-based care organizations. We unify claims, EHR, pharmacy, lab, and ADT data into one live record and put an AI copilot next to every team that depends on it: quality/Stars, pharmacy, care management, provider network, and risk adjustment. The copilots don't just surface insights. They do the work, from engaging members for preventative care using multi-channel communications to preparing provider field reps with everything they need before they walk in the door. So teams spend time on relationships, not admin.
companies.story: Pelica 是面向价值型医疗的人工智能操作系统，整合数据并自动化工作流。想象你是一家医疗机构的护理协调员，每天要处理来自不同系统的患者数据，还要打电话提醒患者做预防性检查，繁琐且容易遗漏。Pelica 把所有数据整合到一个实时记录中，人工智能副驾驶能自动执行这些任务，比如多渠道通知患者、为现场代表准备资料。公司来自 YC 春季 2025 批次，正在招聘，团队五人，值得关注。

companies.name: Code Four
companies.originalOneLiner: Modernizing the police workflow.
companies.originalDescription: Code Four slashes the administrative burden on law enforcement through AI-driven automation. Officers spend up to a third of their shifts manually transcribing body camera footage, creating inaccuracies, reducing transparency, and cutting into frontline duties. We're here to eliminate these inefficiencies by integrating with body cameras, record management systems, and digital evidence management systems—acting as a software layer for data processing. We free the most overworked and underappreciated people in the world: police officers.
companies.story: Code Four 用人工智能自动化警察的行政工作，特别是警员转录执法记录仪视频的环节。想象你是一名警官，每天要花三分之一的时间手动转录视频，不仅枯燥还容易出错，减少了街头巡逻时间。Code Four 集成到执法记录仪和记录管理系统，自动处理数据，生成报告，让警官回归一线工作。公司来自 YC 春季 2025 批次，正在招聘，团队三人，值得关注。

readings.title: Startup creates tech for pain-free tattoos
readings.story: 很多人第一次纹身前，最担心的不是图案好不好看，而是那根针扎下去到底有多疼。这种顾虑让不少想尝试的人一直犹豫，也让纹身师很难吸引新手客户。现在有创业公司想用技术把疼痛感降下来，听起来像是直接回应了每个怕疼的人。这篇新闻之所以值得留意，是因为它不只是在讲一个新产品，而是在展示技术怎么改变一个传统又依赖个人体验的行业。读的时候可以注意，他们是怎么找到疼痛这个痛点的，又用什么思路去解决，是改进设备、改变操作方式，还是完全换一种思路，这些选择背后其实反映了对用户心理的理解。

readings.title: Talks to sell PayPal to Stripe and Advent are heating up
readings.story: 在支付行业里，大公司之间的合并或收购从来不是小事，它往往意味着市场格局要重新洗牌。如果你平时用 PayPal 付款，或者关注 Stripe 这类支付服务商的发展，可能会好奇为什么突然传出这样的消息。这篇报道来自 TechCrunch，它把谈判升温的过程摆了出来，让人看到资本和战略是怎么推动公司走向合并的。读的时候，不妨留意作者如何解释各方为什么要谈，是看中对方的技术、用户，还是为了对抗更大的竞争对手，这些判断能帮你理解支付行业未来的走向，也能让你对商业谈判背后的逻辑多一层认识。

readings.title: The Next Big Influencer Is This 4-Foot-Tall Robot From China
readings.story: 刷短视频时，你可能已经见过一些机器人跳舞、打招呼甚至带货，但一个四英尺高的机器人成为大网红，听起来还是有点新鲜。这件事之所以让人好奇，是因为它把机器人和社交媒体这两个看似不搭界的领域连在了一起。这篇来自 WIRED Business 的文章，正好讲了这个现象。它不只是介绍一个产品，而是在探讨人们为什么会关注一个机器人，是觉得可爱、新奇，还是真的把它当成了有性格的角色。读的时候，可以想想作者是怎么分析机器人走红的原因，是技术突破、内容策略，还是正好踩中了人们对陪伴和娱乐的需求，这些角度或许能让你对机器人的未来有新的看法。

companies.name: Embedder
companies.originalOneLiner: Hardware-Aware AI for Embedded Software Development
companies.originalDescription: Embedder is an AI agent for embedded software. It reads your datasheets and schematics, writes the code, flashes the board, runs the tests, and fixes its own mistakes. Testing is hardware-in-the-loop: Embedder drives the equipment your team already owns (debug probes, logic analyzers, power profilers, oscilloscopes) and validates firmware on real silicon, not just against a compiler. Embedder works with some of the top semiconductor ecosystems in the world, supporting 500+ MCUs and 3,000+ peripherals.
companies.story: 这是一家做嵌入式软件开发工具的公司。想象你是一个嵌入式工程师，正在为一款新的物联网设备编写固件，但芯片手册厚得像字典，电路图又复杂，你经常要花好几个小时查资料、写代码、烧录、测试，然后发现一个错误，再从头来一遍。Embedder 的智能体能够读取数据手册和原理图，自动写代码、烧录到开发板、运行测试，甚至自己修复错误。它还能驱动你团队已有的调试探针、逻辑分析仪、示波器等设备，在真实芯片上验证固件，而不是仅仅通过编译器。这家公司来自 YC 夏季 2025 批次，目前团队 6 人，正在招聘，已经支持 500 多种微控制器和 3000 多种外设，值得关注。

companies.name: Floot
companies.originalOneLiner: The easiest way for non-coders to build apps with AI.
companies.originalDescription: Floot lets non-coders & entrepreneurs build real web apps that actually work. We’re taking a new approach by building everything from the ground up for AI. ✨ Try building an app at floot.com Existing AI app builders fall short of enabling non-coders to build real, serious apps. They often: - Break down when building anything more than a prototype or toy app - Have non-coders stuck with errors they don’t understand - Require non-coders to handle multiple services designed for developers (e.g. for backend, database, hosting, etc) The fundamental problem: these AI app builders just cobble together existing developer tools and slap AI on top, but these tools were designed for humans and not for AI. The result? Non-coders get excited, start building, hit a wall, and then abandon their projects. Floot is purpose-built for AI. Our secret sauce: 1) Instead of reusing a coding framework designed for humans, we created a specialized framework that dictates how AI should write code and how the code runs on our infrastructure. This allows us to enforce best practices, detect errors earlier, and give the best feedback to the AI. As a result, Floot can write better code and fix issues more effectively. 2) Floot has the entire tech stack built-in (backend, database, hosting, etc) so building and managing an app feels seamless, especially for non-coders. And because we control every layer of the stack, we can optimize each layer for AI-first coding. Because of this, non-coders can get more done with less time and prompting. They can finally build serious apps that work, instead of getting stuck in frustrating error loops and then abandoning their projects. We also built a highly scalable hosting system directly on AWS so Floot apps can handle real traffic and business demands. This means non-coders can build, deploy, and scale their apps on a single platform seamlessly. Plus, Floot is really fun to use! Try building an app at floot.com
companies.story: 这家公司做的是让非程序员也能用人工智能构建真正可用的网页应用。想象你是一个小企业主，想做一个客户预约系统，但你不懂代码，用现有的 人工智能 应用构建器，一开始很兴奋，结果建到一半就卡住了，错误信息看不懂，还要自己去配置后端、数据库和托管服务，最后只能放弃。Floot 从底层为 人工智能 重新设计，而不是把现有开发者工具拼凑起来。它让非程序员能够构建严肃的应用，而不是只能做原型或玩具。这家公司来自 YC 夏季 2025 批次，团队 4 人，正在招聘，官网 floot.com 可以试用，值得关注。

companies.name: Channel3
companies.originalOneLiner: Database of every product on the internet
companies.originalDescription: Channel3 is building a database of every product on the internet. Google and OpenAI maintain vast product graphs, but keep that valuable data to themselves. Channel3 gives every developer access, opening a world of possibility for new shopping experiences across any vertical. For instance, developers could build AI fashion stylists or give their agents shopping capabilities. We don’t just collect product data; we actually understand it. With the latest image classification and reasoning models, we can match products across merchants—even when listings and images differ—recognize variants, and surface the perfect matches for every search. As we grow, we’ll capture unique insights into what users want, click, and buy. As AI models get smarter and cheaper, our flywheel accelerates: our catalog will improve, and it will be even easier for developers and vibe-coders to build on our infrastructure. To further incentivize building on Channel3, we provide built-in monetization; developers earn commissions on sales they drive. Alex discovered this need while building an AI tutor that could recommend products and earn affiliate revenue. When no solution existed, he persuaded his smartest friend from Duke and former co-founder George to leave Palantir and build Channel3 together.
companies.story: 这家公司想建立一个包含互联网上所有产品的数据库。想象你是一个电商平台的开发者，想为用户提供智能购物助手，比如根据用户风格推荐衣服，但你没有产品数据，因为 Google 和 OpenAI 的数据不对外开放。Channel3 让开发者可以访问全面的产品数据，用图像分类和推理模型匹配不同商家的产品，即使图片和描述不同也能识别变体。这家公司来自 YC 夏季 2025 批次，位于纽约，团队 5 人，正在招聘。随着 人工智能 模型更智能更便宜，他们的数据飞轮会加速，值得关注。

companies.name: IMPACT Drones
companies.originalOneLiner: Air Defense as a Service for Civilian Infrastructure.
companies.originalDescription: IMPACT builds autonomous interceptor drones that ship in a sealed box. The box sits at the site it protects (data centers, power grid, airports, bases) with no crew on the pad. When sensors cue a hostile drone, an interceptor pierces its own frangible lid, launches, and rams the target, guided by onboard visual navigation that keeps working when GPS is jammed. Legacy effectors cost $1M+ per shot against $30k threats; our interceptors cost like the threat and launches scale with the swarm. Sites subscribe to protection instead of buying missiles: hardware, reloads, and monitoring included. Air defense as a Service.
companies.story: 这是一家做自主拦截无人机防御系统的公司，为关键基础设施提供空防服务。想象你是一个数据中心的安全主管，担心有恶意无人机侵入，但传统防御系统每发导弹要百万美元，成本太高。IMPACT 的拦截无人机装在一个密封箱里，放在保护站点，当传感器探测到敌机时，拦截器会破盖而出，撞击目标，自带视觉导航，即使 GPS 被干扰也能工作。站点订阅保护服务，而不是购买导弹，硬件、重新装填和监控都包含在内。这家公司来自 YC 夏季 2026 批次，团队 2 人，位于旧金山，值得关注。

companies.name: Hemlock
companies.originalOneLiner: Force-sensing wristband for training robotic AI
companies.originalDescription: Every serious robotics lab is bottlenecked on the same thing: demonstration data. The field has converged on egocentric video and hand pose as the substrate, and both are now cheap to collect at scale. What neither of them contains is force. A video of someone picking up an egg and a video of someone picking up a rock are nearly identical in pixel space and nearly identical in joint angles. They differ almost entirely in a quantity nobody is recording. Policies trained without it learn geometry and inherit no sense of touch. Hemlock closes that gap at the source. Our device, the Bracelet, is a wrist-worn surface EMG band that reads the electrical activity of the forearm muscles that actually drive the hand, which means it recovers contraction force directly rather than inferring it from motion. This distinction is the whole thesis: force cannot be reconstructed downstream of kinematics, because a hand squeezing hard isometrically and a hand resting can occupy the identical pose. Muscle signal is the only non-invasive channel that separates them.
companies.story: 这是一家做力传感腕带的公司，用于训练机器人人工智能。想象你是一个机器人研究员，正在收集演示数据来训练机器人操作技能，你用视频和手部姿态，但视频无法捕捉力的大小，比如拿起鸡蛋和拿起石头的视频几乎一样，但力完全不同。Hemlock 的腕带通过表面肌电读取前臂肌肉的电活动，直接恢复收缩力，而不是从运动推断。这能弥补机器人学习中的触觉缺失。这家公司来自 YC 秋季 2026 批次，团队 1 人，位于洛杉矶，正在招聘，值得关注。

companies.originalOneLiner: YC S26) – Agents that do read-only debugging in prod
companies.originalDescription: YC S26) – Agents that do read-only debugging in prod

readings.title: Thrive’s Joshua Kushner chides Silicon Valley VCs over AI euphoria
readings.story: 硅谷的投资者们向来喜欢追逐下一个大浪潮，每当新技术出现，总有人高呼这是改变世界的时刻。但 Joshua Kushner 却在这个时候站出来泼冷水，提醒大家 人工智能 狂热可能过头了。这就像在一场热闹的派对上，有人突然关掉音乐，让大家冷静下来想想。这篇文章值得一读，因为它提供了一个难得的反思视角，让我们看到狂热背后的隐忧。读的时候，可以留意作者是如何分析投资过热的现象，以及他提出的理性判断依据是什么。

readings.title: The Week’s 10 Biggest Funding Rounds: Data, Neolab, AI Infrastructure, Defense And AI Coding Lead
readings.story: 每周都有大量创业公司获得融资，但总有那么几笔特别引人注目，它们往往预示着资本流向的新方向。这周的榜单上，数据、人工智能 基础设施、国防和 人工智能 编程占据了主导，这背后反映的是市场对技术底层能力的重视。如果你是一个关注技术趋势的人，或者只是想了解钱都往哪儿去了，这篇文章是个不错的起点。读的时候，可以思考为什么这些领域会集中获得资金，以及它们可能如何影响未来的技术格局。

readings.title: The Pulse: Meta’s self-inflicted resignation-wave
readings.story: 在一家公司里，员工离职是常事，但如果离职潮是由于公司自身政策引起的，那就值得深思了。Meta 最近就遇到了这样的情况，据称因为某些内部决策，导致一波员工主动辞职。这听起来像是一个管理失误的案例，但背后可能涉及更深层的公司文化问题。这篇文章能帮你理解大公司里政策与人心之间的微妙平衡。读的时候，可以关注作者如何分析事件的前因后果，以及他从中提炼出的管理教训。

companies.name: Moss
companies.originalOneLiner: Real-time semantic search for Conversational AI
companies.originalDescription: Moss is building the real-time semantic search runtime for conversational and multimodal AI. Our system enables voice agents, copilots, and chat interfaces to retrieve, reason, and respond in sub-10 ms, delivering the responsiveness that makes AI interactions feel truly natural. If you’ve ever built a conversational or voice AI product, you’ve felt the lag. That moment when an agent pauses and the illusion of intelligence breaks. The bottleneck is almost always retrieval. Each query hops across networks and databases, adding delay and cost. Moss eliminates that gap by keeping retrieval close to where the agent runs. Moss runs natively across browsers, mobile devices, and servers with an optimized vector index built in Rust and WebAssembly. It enables teams to build AI products that feel instant, contextual, and adaptive. The experiences that sustain engagement and unlock new kinds of interaction. For our customers, this translates into tangible business value: stronger user retention, higher conversion, and entirely new product categories made possible by real-time understanding. Moss is already powering production pilots across voice AI and developer platforms, achieving sub-10 ms retrieval and 70–90% token savings compared to traditional pipelines.
companies.story: 这家公司做的是对话式人工智能的实时语义搜索基础设施。想象你正在开发一个语音助手，用户刚说完一句话，系统却要等上几百毫秒才回应，那种停顿瞬间打破了对话的流畅感。Moss 把检索过程压缩到十毫秒以内，让智能体在浏览器、手机和服务器上都能快速找到相关信息。它用 Rust 和 WebAssembly 构建了一个优化的向量索引，让检索紧挨着智能体运行，省去了跨网络和数据库的延迟。如果你想让语音助手或聊天机器人反应得像真人一样快，这个方案值得关注，因为响应速度往往是体验好坏的关键。

Vector combines premier lawyers/paralegals (averaging 10+ years of Big Law experience) + custom-built AI, so our clients get world class startup legal service at a fraction of Big Law rates. See our client testimonials - https://www.vectorlegal.com/testimonials. Services: fundraise & priced rounds | customer contracts | international flips | complex formations | grow your team | agentic data rooms | e-signatures | cap table management | legal health checks | mergers & acquisitions | co-founder separations | dissolutions.

Backed by Y Combinator, Clicks helps teams improve accuracy, shorten turnaround times, and reduce operating costs, with SOC 2 Type II and HIPAA compliance built in.
companies.story: 这家公司做的是医疗后台运营的人工智能智能体。想象你是一家诊所的运营负责人，每天要处理大量的保险理赔、账单和病历记录，这些工作繁琐且容易出错。Clicks Health 的智能体可以自动操作电子病历系统、保险门户和遗留软件，按照现有流程处理例外情况，并在需要人类判断时升级给人工。它通过了 SOC 2 Type II 和 HIPAA 合规认证，意味着数据安全有保障。对于想降低成本、提高准确率的医疗机构来说，这套系统能减轻不少负担。

companies.name: Mbodi AI

companies.originalDescription: Teach robots new skills through natural language and run reliably in production in minutes. Mbodi combines generative AI and agent orchestration, turning everyday language and quick demos into precise, reliable robot actions for industrial automation.
companies.story: 这家公司专注于让工业机器人像人一样学习和操作。想象你是一个工厂的质检员，每天需要手动编程机器人去完成不同的分拣或装配任务，这既耗时又需要专业技能。Mbodi AI 让你可以用自然语言和快速演示来教机器人新技能，几分钟内就能在生产环境中可靠运行。它结合了生成式人工智能和智能体编排，把日常语言转化为精确的机器人动作。对于希望灵活调整生产线、应对多变任务的工厂来说，这能大大提升效率。

companies.name: Klarify
companies.originalOneLiner: AI Agent for Therapists
companies.originalDescription: Klarify handles every job a therapist does other than the therapy itself, from clinical notes and treatment plans to insurance claims and finding new clients. Therapists hold the world together. They also run businesses, file insurance claims, write letters, fill forms, supervise new grads, and do hours of paperwork every night. Practice management software has existed for decades. It records what therapists do. It can't actually do any of it. Klara is the AI at the heart of Klarify. She handles notes, treatment plans, clinical letters, insurance claims, between-session resources, supervision prep, and finding new clients. Nearly 8,300 therapists use Klarify today. Our mission is to empower therapists, not replace them. So they can focus on the one thing only a human can do. Be present with their client.
companies.story: 这是一家为心理治疗师打造人工智能助手的公司。假如你是一位心理咨询师，每天除了做咨询，还要花好几个小时写临床记录、制定治疗计划、处理保险理赔和寻找新客户。Klarify 的智能体 Klara 可以帮你处理这些文书工作，包括写笔记、治疗计划、临床信件、保险理赔、准备督导材料等。目前已有近八千三百名治疗师在使用。它不是为了取代治疗师，而是让你能把精力放在与来访者相处上，这或许是这个职业最需要的东西。

companies.name: Fort
companies.originalOneLiner: Strength Tracking Wearable
companies.originalDescription: Fort is a wearable that tracks strength training for people who care about longevity. Other wearables make you manually log every rep, set, and exercise, then provide unhelpful feedback or underestimate strength-related fatigue. We use heart rate and motion data to track your strength workouts for you, then provide thoughtful, actionable feedback that helps you achieve your goals.
companies.story: 这家公司做的是力量训练追踪的可穿戴设备。想象你是一个注重长期健康的健身爱好者，每次举铁都要手动记录组数和次数，而其他手环只能给出模糊的反馈，甚至低估你的疲劳程度。Fort 通过心率传感器和运动数据自动识别你的训练动作，并给出有针对性的建议，帮助你更好地达成目标。它不只是一个手机应用，而是把能力放进了腕带设备里，让你在训练时无需掏出手机就能获得数据反馈，这更符合实际锻炼场景。

companies.name: Bullet
companies.originalOneLiner: YC S26) – A Faster Coding Agent
companies.originalDescription: YC S26) – A Faster Coding Agent
companies.story: 这是来自 YC 夏季 2026 批次的一个编码智能体项目，定位是更快的编程助手。想象你是一个软件工程师，正在处理一个复杂的 bug，你希望智能体能快速理解代码库并给出修改建议。Bullet 的目标是让编码智能体在速度和效率上更进一步。虽然目前信息有限，但作为 YC 支持的创业公司，它可能代表了开发工具领域的新方向。对于开发者来说，更快的编码智能体意味着更少等待、更多产出，值得关注。

companies.name: Clay
companies.originalOneLiner: Data enrichment and go-to-market automation platform.
companies.originalDescription: Clay gives sales and growth teams a way to gather customer data, enrich leads, and build outbound workflows without stitching together many small tools.
companies.story: 这家公司做的是数据丰富化和市场推广自动化平台。想象你是一个销售主管，每天需要从各种渠道收集潜在客户的信息，手动整理并发送个性化邮件，这既繁琐又容易遗漏。Clay 提供了一个整合的工具，让你能自动抓取客户数据、丰富线索信息，并构建外呼流程，而不用拼接多个小工具。对于销售和增长团队来说，这能节省大量时间，让你专注于真正重要的沟通和转化。

companies.name: Lovable
companies.originalOneLiner: AI product builder for turning prompts into applications.
companies.originalDescription: Lovable lets people describe an app or product idea and generate working software faster, especially for early prototypes and small product teams.
companies.story: 这家公司做的是人工智能产品构建器，让用户通过描述想法来生成可用的软件。想象你是一个产品经理，有了一个新应用的点子，但写代码需要几周时间，而 Lovable 可以让你用自然语言描述需求，快速生成一个原型或最小可行产品。它特别适合早期原型验证和小型产品团队，能大幅缩短从想法到实现的周期。虽然它不是 YC 公司，但这类工具正在改变软件构建的方式，值得关注。

companies.name: Cognition
companies.originalOneLiner: AI software engineering agents.
companies.originalDescription: Cognition works on AI systems that can take on software engineering tasks, plan changes, use developer tools, and move beyond single code suggestions.
companies.story: 这家公司致力于开发能够承担软件工程任务的人工智能系统。想象你是一个工程负责人，面临一个大型代码重构项目，需要规划变更、使用各种开发工具，并确保不影响现有功能。Cognition 的人工智能可以理解任务、制定计划并执行，而不仅仅是给出代码建议。它超越了简单的代码补全，朝着更自主的编程智能体方向发展。对于希望提高开发效率的团队来说，这可能是一个重要的突破方向。

readings.title: Launch HN: Bullet (YC S26) – A Faster Coding Agent
readings.story: 写代码的人大概都经历过这样的时刻：一个任务明明不复杂，但工具反应慢，思路被打断，等它转完圈，你早忘了刚才要改哪里。于是大家总在找更快的助手。这篇讲的就是一个叫 Bullet 的编程代理，号称更快。它出现在 YC 的孵化名单里，又在 Hacker News 上被讨论，本身就说明很多人对“快”这件事有多在意。读的时候可以留意，作者是怎么定义“快”的，是响应速度，还是少问问题，或者别的什么。看他们怎么拆解这个目标，也许比结论更有意思。

readings.title: [AINews] SpaceXAI Grok 4.6 and Grok @Bot
readings.story: 如果你偶尔刷技术新闻，会发现人工智能的消息总是又密又快，今天这个模型，明天那个机器人，好像不跟上就落后了。这篇来自 Latent Space 的简报，讲的正是这类动态，标题里提到了 Grok 4.6 和一个叫 @Bot 的东西。它可能是在帮读者梳理发生了什么，以及背后谁在推动。读的时候不妨把它当成一个窗口，看看作者如何从一堆噪音里挑出重点，又如何判断哪条消息真正有分量。这样你就不只是被动接收，而是能自己掂量变化的分量。

readings.title: GitHub availability report: July 2026
readings.story: 很多团队把代码托管在 GitHub 上，平时没消息就是好消息，可一旦某天网站卡了或者提交失败，大家才会意识到，原来自己这么依赖它。这份报告是 GitHub 官方发布的七月可用性说明，属于那种平时没人看、出问题时才被翻出来的文档。但它其实值得提前读：你可以从中了解，一个大型平台如何定义“可用”，如何统计故障，又如何向用户交代。读的时候可以关注他们用了哪些指标，哪些事件被列出来，这能帮你理解，所谓稳定到底意味着什么。

companies.name: Rhizome AI
companies.location: New York City, NY, USA; Remote
companies.originalOneLiner: Agent Platform for Life Sciences
companies.originalDescription: It takes 500,000 days of office work to bring a drug to market. We want to make it 5. To get there, we need agents doing most of the work. Today, our research agent is the best way to know what the FDA thinks. Users ask a question and get an answer backed by up to 1,000 documents, where each statement has a citation. It’s the best because we have the best retrieval engine. We’ve tuned it on our life science-specific dataset, and we find what others miss. As more teams use Rhizome, we gain more data on what regulatory professionals actually need, which makes retrieval even better. This flywheel is how we become the retrieval engine that powers all human and agent work in life sciences. Chetan started his career as a research engineer, but quickly realized he enjoyed building more than research. He joined EvolutionaryScale as their sole founding product engineer, launching their developer-scientist platform and scaling to tens of thousands of users and billions of API calls. He was also #16 at Instabase helping banks with document processing, closing $7m as the technical closer. Agents can do magical things today, but most in life sciences only use them to edit emails. Agents are missing the context they need to 100x the number of drugs we can bring to market. Rhizome AI is focused on that critical problem.
companies.story: Rhizome AI 是一家为生命科学领域打造智能体平台的公司，专注于帮助药物研发和监管事务团队处理海量文档。想象你是一名监管事务分析师，正在准备一份提交给 FDA 的申请，需要查阅上千份文件来确认最新的审批要求。过去，这要耗费数周时间，而现在你只需向 Rhizome 的研究智能体提问，它就能从最多 1000 份文件中提取答案，并为每句话提供引用来源。它的检索引擎经过生命科学数据集的专门调优，能发现其他工具遗漏的信息。作为 YC 冬季 2026 批次的一员，团队目前正在招聘，虽然只有一人，但这款产品已经吸引了早期用户的关注。它之所以值得关注，是因为它把药物上市所需的海量办公室工作从 50 万天压缩到 5 天，这可能会彻底改变监管流程的效率。

companies.name: Valgo
companies.originalOneLiner: Insurance risk layer for physical AI
companies.originalDescription: Insurers struggle to price autonomous systems because the historical data simply doesn't exist. Your car insurance draws from over 30 billion claims records, but autonomous trucks and robots have nearly zero. Valgo is the risk quantification platform that closes that gap. We are building probabilistic models of routes, tasks, and environments from the bottom up. We output a simulated loss estimate that insurers need to price coverage. Valgo is the foundational layer that gives insurance providers confidence to properly price autonomy risk. Our team combines expertise in risk estimation for autonomy with deep experience in the insurance industry. Sydney and Robert are Stanford PhDs with leading expertise in safety of physical AI systems. Sydney wrote the textbook on validating safety-critical systems and teaches the course at Stanford. Robert spent 7 years at MIT Lincoln Laboratory on the core team that designed and validated an FAA-certified aircraft collision avoidance system, now a worldwide standard. Jon is a Sloan Fellow from the Stanford GSB and an actuary who spent over 12 years in insurance leadership and led over $5 billion in M&A as head of corporate development for one of the largest insurers in Asia-Pacific.
companies.story: Valgo 是一家为物理人工智能提供保险风险量化平台的公司，专注于解决自动驾驶卡车和机器人等自主系统的定价难题。想象你是一名保险公司的核保人，今天要为一支自动驾驶卡车车队报价，但你发现几乎没有历史事故数据可以参考，而传统汽车保险有超过 300 亿条理赔记录。Valgo 从零开始构建路线、任务和环境的概率模型，输出模拟损失估计，让你能够为自主系统定价。两位创始人是斯坦福博士，一位写过验证安全关键系统的教科书，另一位在 MIT 林肯实验室工作过七年。作为 YC 冬季 2026 批次项目，团队三人，目前没有招聘。它的价值在于填补了自主系统保险数据缺失的空白，为保险公司提供信心来承保这类新兴风险。

companies.name: Overshoot
companies.originalOneLiner: AI Infra for real-time vision applications
companies.originalDescription: Overshoot makes it easy for developers to build and run real-time vision applications. AI can see and understand the physical world. This unlocks new applications in physical security, safety, gaming, robotics and general consumer products. Soon, video agents will watch your home and your pet when you’re away. However, existing platforms make it painful for developers to build these real-time applications. Slow inference. Limited model availability. Break at scale. Overshoot solves this. Today, 300+ developers connect live video feeds to the largest collection of Vision Language Models with 3 lines of code. And get responses in less than 200ms. 10x faster than any existing inference platform. Zero infra headache. Our moat is focus. Image and Video are fundamentally different modalities from text. By focusing on them, we are able to make strong technical leaps from codec, streaming protocols to inference engines. Younes and Zakaria are cousins. Zakaria graduated top of his class at LSE and MIT, and later built low-latency high-throughput pricing systems (surge) at Uber and inference engines at Meta. He previously built and sold a software product and won several prominent AI hackathons. Younes was a founding engineer at Cosmonio (later acquired by Intel). He built a training and serving Computer Vision platform from scratch. He witnessed firsthand customers abandoning traditional Computer Vision because it lacked the “general” intelligence LLMs have today. Together we’ve shipped large-scale systems and know where they break.
companies.story: Overshoot 是一家为实时视觉应用提供人工智能基础设施的公司，让开发者能够轻松构建和运行视频理解应用。想象你是一名开发者，正在为一个家庭安全产品添加实时宠物监控功能，但现有的推理平台响应太慢，模型选择也有限。Overshoot 允许你用三行代码连接实时视频流，并在 200 毫秒内获得响应，速度比现有平台快十倍。它支持大量视觉语言模型，并且专注于视频和图像，不同于文本处理。作为 YC 冬季 2026 批次项目，团队五人，目前已有超过 300 名开发者使用。它之所以值得关注，是因为它解决了实时视频推理的瓶颈，为物理安全、游戏和机器人等应用打开了大门。

companies.name: Libra Robotics
companies.originalOneLiner: Multi-robot collaboration for harsh environments on Earth.
companies.originalDescription: We build collaborative robot squads for solar farm construction. High labor costs, labor shortages, and unpredictable productivity make infrastructure difficult to build in places that are remote, harsh, or empty. We are building robots to unlock places once considered too difficult to develop. Solar is our first proving ground, spanning utility-scale, commercial and industrial, community solar, agrivoltaic, and other projects. Unlike solutions that automate only one task, or even part of one, we cover the workflow after PV module pallets arrive on-site: transportation, installation, alignment, and fastening. Each robot has a specific role, and fleets can be configured based on each project’s cost and schedule requirements. Our robots operate autonomously with remote supervision. One person can supervise 4+ robots through a screen and an e-stop button, without being physically present or teleoperating them. Our robotic fleet has also been tested at night, paving the way for 24/7 operation. We work directly with EPCs through a Robotics-as-a-Service model, requiring no robot purchase or large upfront capital investment. We also work with racking and PV module manufacturers to certify compatibility and give customers confidence in deployment. Purpose-built hardware, multimodal sensing, and physical AI software help our robots handle real-world construction uncertainty.
companies.story: Libra Robotics 是一家为恶劣环境建造协作机器人队伍的公司，目前专注于太阳能发电厂的建设。想象你是一名太阳能项目施工经理，正在一个偏远的沙漠地带负责安装光伏板，但劳动力短缺且成本高昂，工期一再延误。Libra 的机器人团队覆盖从光伏板托盘到达现场后的运输、安装、对准和固定整个流程。每个机器人都有特定角色，一个操作员可以远程监督四台以上机器人。作为 YC 夏季 2026 批次项目，团队两人，目前没有招聘。它之所以值得关注，是因为它通过多机器人协作，解锁了那些被认为难以开发的地区，解决了基础设施建设的劳动力难题。

companies.name: Kinro
companies.originalOneLiner: Autonomous insurance brokerage for small businesses
companies.originalDescription: We are building the first autonomous insurance brokerage. We hit $1M in annual revenue building insurance workflows for brokers. Then we realized the bigger opportunity was replacing them. In the US, there are 36 million SMBs, and 77% are underinsured because distribution is broken. Brokers can’t serve low-premium SMBs profitably: a $2K policy takes almost as much work as a $20K one. Kinro changes that. Our AI agents handle the full broker workflow 24/7, from finding prospects to binding policies. In 3 weeks, we got licensed in 24 states and appointed by 10 carriers. Last week, our agents autonomously bound 9 policies. Before Kinro, Pierre was an AI researcher at DeepMind. Corentin was Chief Insurance Officer at an insurtech. Parth built ML systems at Zoox.
companies.story: Kinro 是一家为小企业提供自主保险经纪服务的公司，用人工智能代理处理从寻找客户到绑定保单的全部流程。想象你是一名小企业主，经营一家社区面包店，想买一份商业保险，但传统经纪人因为保费太低而不愿服务。Kinro 的人工智能代理 24/7 工作，在 3 周内获得了 24 个州的牌照，并与 10 家保险公司签约。团队三人，来自 DeepMind、保险科技和 Zoox，目前正在招聘。作为 YC 春季 2026 批次项目，它已经实现了 100 万美元的年收入，并自主绑定了 9 份保单。它之所以值得关注，是因为它瞄准了 77% 的美国小企业保险不足的问题，用自动化降低了服务成本。

companies.name: Perseus Defense
companies.originalOneLiner: America's Golden Dome for Drones
